full_judgment: 7. It is true that the learned Subordinate Judge of positive finding that the plaintiff being a pardanashin village woman did not get any independent and impartial advise at the time of sale and the defendant obtained the sale deed on the plea of executing and registering the deed of kai khalashi and no consideration money was passed, the kabalas in question being product of fraud the same is liable to be set aside but still no formal order has been passed by the learned Subordinate Judge declaring the deed of sale in respect of the suit land void and the same is set aside and further the learned Additional District Judge who heard the appeal although affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court dismissing the appeal did not also pass any such formal order declaring the said deeds of sale cancelled. We ourselves opine that it is a technical omission done inadvertently by the Courts below in as much as the Courts have already found the sale deeds in respect of the suit land have been obtained by practising fraud and in a deceitful manner. It is also prayed by the plaintiff by way of amendment of the plaint that the properties transferred in favour of defendant nos. 1-3 on 19.3.75 and the properties were transferred in favour of defendant nos. 4-6 on 18.3.75 and the properties were transferred in favour of defendant nos. 1-4, 6, 7 and 8 on 20.3.75 by the defendant no. 9 on the basis of registered kabala dated 19.3.75 and 20.3.75 and 1.4.75 and also 31.3.75, relevant kabalas are all product of fraud and the same is collusive, illegal, without jurisdiction, inoperative, void and declaration may be made upon declaration of title of the plaintiff and also by giving khas possession thereof.
